name: WINDBREAK FIELDS
brief: Scout the open fields before committing armor. Secure North Farm and the Grain Exchange, then cut the eastern road. The exchange opens forward resupply; the checkpoint denies enemy reserves.

operation.title: CUT THE EASTERN ROAD
operation.brief: North Farm covers the northern approach. The Grain Exchange adds 3 supply/s and a forward reinforcement arrival. Hold East Checkpoint to stop new enemy reserves; already deployed troops remain. Secure all three positions for 55 seconds.

authorship.status: authored fictional regional battlefield; gameplay and art acceptance remain provisional
authorship.inspiration: Original authored, compressed fictional adaptation of the Sevastopol / Heraclean Peninsula geography. Public historic maps inform bay, valley, rail and settlement relationships; all battlefield streets, dimensions, forces and objectives are invented. No survey or current infrastructure accuracy is claimed.

sources.title: Ancient City of Tauric Chersonese and its Chora — UNESCO
sources.use: Historic urban grid and agricultural/vineyard hinterland morphology; consulted 2026-10-23.

sources.title: Sebastopol and Western Crimea, 1919 — University of South Florida Maps ETC
sources.use: Broad coast, relief, railway-valley and settlement relationships only; consulted 2026-10-23. No map imagery copied.

sources.title: Plan de la Chersonèse — Library of Congress
sources.use: Historic peninsula / bay relationship reference; no historical fortifications or troop positions reproduced.

assumptions: Battlefields are independent operations; adjacency and matching boundaries are not required.
Agricultural parcels and lane geometry are original gameplay designs, not a reconstruction or current survey.
Buildings, hedges, trees and parked agricultural equipment use the existing shared asset and collision rules.
Windbreaks offer sight obstruction and route choices; they are not destructible crop or farming simulation.
